explanation: Compared with erdosproblems.com/1036: Erdős-Hajnal's hypothesis is no complete bipartite graph or complement on more than c log n vertices. Lean's NoLargeBiclique forbids only balanced K_{k,k} with 2k>c log n, as the docstring says, which is a weaker hypothesis and hence a stronger theorem than the page's literal wording. The literal unbalanced reading would exclude any graph with a large-degree vertex, so balanced is likely what is meant, but I could not read [ErHa89b] to confirm.
